notes: SPLENDOUR is a whole painted page -- its own chamfered gold frame, no rail and no pills -- hosted by PaintedPage like THE CROWN'S FAVOUR: `page` is the whole painting, its blurred surround included, with the tabs, the tiles and the strip's samples erased. A taller canvas gives its extra height to the grid, so it shows more tiles.

Lifted off the page: the four painted tabs (the lit FRAMES tab's red glow reaches the left margin, so the band is filled from the clean right margin, x 897..904); the nine tiles (each row runs from the left margin's ground to the right margin's with the blended erase: the page is darker at its edges than in its middle); and the strip's samples, a scroll, an enamel chip and three shields. The tabs are the game's one tab strip (tabs_sheet_b via TabStrip); the tiles are placed live from `tile`; the strip shows the lord as the realm sees them.

tile is the gold-laurel tile (the right column's: no seal on it), its frame erased from the ground either side of the laurel, its name plate kept. equip_plate is EQUIP with its word erased: the word is set in type because it changes (EQUIP, TAKE OFF, a price, LOCKED). CLOSE keeps its painted word.

tick_seal, padlock: the worn seal (round-masked off the oak wreath behind it) and the lock, for any screen that marks a cosmetic worn or locked. title_scroll is the strip's scroll, keyed off the strip's ground: a title is written on it. The strip's enamel chip is the Royal Store's icons/colour_chip and colour_chip_face (art/slices/store_2.json), its face tinted with a colour's code; it is not cut twice.

Measured with art/tools/probe.py and grid.py: frame outline x 25..911, y 28..1636 (chamfer ~12); tabs row y 377..448; tiles x 50|338|614, y 461|730|1000, about 276x261 with the name plate at y +199..+243; strip x 48..893, y 1282..1462; EQUIP 93..454 x 1486..1589 (word ink 209..351 x 1523..1563, #FEFCD4); CLOSE 481..844. The chip is 88x100 (rim x 368..455, y 1322..1421); its enamel is the ellipse inside the rim.
